description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EmojiCollector' which manages collections of emojis, including predefined static instances for different emoji categories such as emoticons, people, accessories, nature, food, transport, signs, scape, activity, office, occasions, flags, and uncollected emojis. It includes methods for visiting emojis, generating owned emojis with variants and tags, and nested class 'GroupEmojiCollector' for category-specific emoji filtering.

classes.name: EmojiCollector
classes.description: An abstract class that manages collections of emojis, providing static instances for various emoji categories and methods for processing emojis, including variant detection and tagging.

classes.name: GroupEmojiCollector
classes.description: A nested subclass of EmojiCollector that filters emojis based on category-specific subgroup tags.

methods.name: visitEmoji
methods.description: Adds an emoji to the collection if it matches the category criteria.

methods.name: isMyEmoji
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if an emoji belongs to the specific category.

methods.name: generateOwnedEmojis
methods.description: Generates a list of owned emojis, including variants and additional tags.
